method.algorithm: numpy FFT positive spectral flux; mono 129-tap Hann-windowed sinc lowpass 5kHz then decimated by 4; 1024 Hann window, 110 hop; band peaks >= global p65, 90ms suppression
method.limitations: Mixture only; voice_band is not separated vocals. Peaks are candidates, not phoneme or perceptual beat confirmation. Hop ~10ms, window ~93ms; inspect +/-80ms. No listening approval performed.
method.tempo_lag_resolution_warning: Integer lag gives BPM plateaus; do not interpret hundredths as accuracy.
method.tempo_coherent_flux_note: Best complex phase-coherence magnitude over 120–141 BPM, 0.01 step, on stable-region low-band flux. Numerical estimate, not listening approval.
